release_claim.reason: R2 control-path repairs and further CSS consolidation pass focused and governed sections; exact-artifact independent verification and deferred full certification remain outstanding. Same-file CSS debt is reduced, not eliminated.

findings.finding: Approval capabilities remain self-issuable outside an authenticated human host action
findings.root_cause: Python both minted and consumed approval records, while a same-user writable shared-secret enrollment file supplied no independent host authority.
findings.repair: Approval signing moved entirely into the VS Code extension host using an RSA private key retained in SecretStorage. Python exposes only a read-only verifier locator, verifies exact project/kind/operation/payload/expiry/nonce claims, and consumes each nonce once. The public Python issuer and shared broker-secret CLI were removed.

findings.finding: Relative key-root locators split authentication across child working directories
findings.root_cause: PX_STUDIO_KEY_ROOT was accepted and forwarded without an absolute-path grammar.
findings.repair: Relative configured roots now fail closed; admitted absolute roots are canonicalized before propagation.
findings.independent_verification: R3 OP-M09 passed relative-root rejection and absolute-root canonicalization.

findings.finding: Prefix-based containment check admits an in-project ..broker authority root
findings.root_cause: The JavaScript boundary used a lexical startsWith('..') test and Python did not independently reject project-contained authority roots.
findings.repair: The bridge now uses component-aware canonical containment, and StudioAuthorityStore independently rejects any authority root equal to or beneath the project.

findings.finding: Broker secret rotation or loss can disable all approval-gated mutations
findings.root_cause: A single shared secret and create-only enrollment record had neither proven rotation nor a user-mediated recovery lifecycle.
findings.repair: The host now retains a bounded private-key history, authorizes normal rotation with the old key, offers an explicit modal recovery path when the old key is unavailable, and backs up the prior verifier before recovery.
findings.independent_verification: R3 OP-M10 passed rotation, continued operation, explicit recovery, denial, and bounded backup behavior.

findings.finding: CSS ownership improved but same-file selector duplication remains substantial
findings.root_cause: Legacy compatibility generations retain sequential same-file overrides even after cross-file ownership was consolidated.
findings.repair: Redundant base/override blocks were merged without changing the layer contract. Duplicate selectors fell from 167 to 157 and duplicate occurrences from 208 to 193; the enforced baseline was ratcheted and cross-file duplication remains zero.
